body: Quick pass (UMA) @ ab0f88fa: quick gate green on the final head (motion, app, ui; 12.1 min), clippy clean, 3 external goldens added, none moved, body complete. Kept as a DRAFT on purpose: stacked on #1045 (on #1005); merges at the cut with #1005.
M5 is refreshing this PR with main (its author session has been idle)

M5 stopped refreshing this PR (nothing pushed). The textual conflicts resolve cleanly (generate.rs: the geom/holder/cutter block moved to the top of the job in main, so the `thread_op::root_cutter` line goes after it; Tool literals need both `pitch_min` and main's `turning`; ui mod.rs/pages.rs keep both). But after the merge main's #1000/#1096 guard `solid_law_goldens::every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes` fails on this PR's new posted goldens: `thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc` (and the stacked `thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc`) are posted but no gate judges their program. Fix needs a decision from the author: judge them in `verdicts()`/`posted_gates`, or name them in `UNJUDGED` with a reason. Also `crates/tools/src/thread_mill.rs` and `tests/recorded_post_streams.rs` need the other side's new Tool field.

This conflicts with main (37d93ae5). Please `git merge upstream/main` (NeoTech/Camcraft main) into the branch and push. Conflicting files: crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs plus the golden/test lists (golden_cl.rs, mill2d_b/c, operations.rs, solid_law_goldens.rs, drilling/tests.rs, center_cut_owed.rs, ui mod/pages) - ~10 hunks of both-sides test moves around a generate.rs change; merge main and re-apply.

Merged the refreshed parent #1045 (`issue/992-thread-undrilled` @ d43ccb43, which carries #1005 and upstream/main) into this branch to resolve conflicts; `upstream/main` merged on top was already up to date. New head: d82a8061.

**Conflicts and resolutions**
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, Thread arm: kept both. External (`*external`) keeps #985's own law, `thread_boss::crest_region` on the boss's minor circle with no silhouette, and `thread_round` stays true for it. Internal: `region_for_job`, then #1205's `walls_round` gate on `thread_op::crest_region`, exactly as the parent has it. The undrilled-hole law (`thread_entry::judge`) for holes and `judge_bosses` for bosses are both kept.
- `crates/app/src/operation/thread_op.rs`, `root_cutter`: kept both. It now takes `round: bool` (#1205), so a non-round hole's teeth are judged at full radius. It also narrows by `depth_of(p, external)` (#985). The doc comment now covers both, and the external unit test passes `round = true`.
- `crates/app/tests/hole_wall_flats.rs` (auto-merged, did not compile): added `external: false` to its Thread params.

No refusal was dropped. The round-wall and undrilled rules for internal threads are unchanged.

**Follow-up in this push** (`test(thread)` commit d82a8061): the chain's posted-golden guard (`every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`) now judges this PR's new `nc/thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc`. `posted_gates/thread.rs` has an `external_verdict()`. It regenerates the golden on the stud fixture, with the stock cleared round the boss by the roughing ahead, and checks that the result is byte-identical to the CL golden. It then runs the generator's blocking laws and the post's verification gate, and both pass with no blocking findings. `the_thread_golden_passes_its_gate` asserts both thread goldens are judged. The stud world builders moved from `thread_boss.rs` to `thread_support::boss` so the two suites share them.

`git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the thread chain's files (#1005, #1045, #1137).

**Gate:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green: tools 4s, sim 12s, motion 145s, app 793s, ui 89s. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Open question for review, not changed here: #1205's round-wall test is applied to holes only. A polygonal boss (a hex stud) gets no equivalent, so its crest law reads the minor circle as before.

The PR stays a draft and is still stacked on #1045.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
taken by UMA for the refresh onto #1045 @ d82a806

Refreshed (UMA). Head is now 4f15b9b3.

**Merges**
- a914d12e merges the refreshed #1045 (`issue/992-thread-undrilled` @ 6dd3f773) into this branch. Conflicts were in generate.rs, thread_op.rs, operation/mod.rs, stock_sim.rs and tests/mcp.rs.
- 0298f3c0 merges upstream/main @ 683802be. It merged clean.
- 4f15b9b3 merges upstream/main @ 36035af8. It merged clean. This main already carries #1005 and #1045. The two merge bases (6dd3f773 and 683802be) had left GitHub reading the PR as dirty, and this merge fixes that.

**Resolutions**
- Internal threads keep #1005's #1071 laws unchanged: `thread_rims::major_rims` behind `walls_round`, plus the solid-law grant `thread_op::bores`.
- External threads keep #985's own laws: `thread_boss::crest_region` on the minor circle, the neighbour law, and `judge_bosses`.
- `bores` gives no grant to an external thread, because a boss is not a bore. `root_cutter` returns, but for external threads only, narrowed by the external depth. So the grant and a narrowed cutter are never stacked, as `894-thread-mill.md` "The refresh against main" item 2 requires.
- mod.rs and mcp.rs keep both sides.
- stock_sim keeps the electrode arm, and its cutter arm reads `thread_op::sim_radius`.
- coarse_rims and thread_mill_rim get `external: false`.
- No check was dropped.

**Boss decision** (commit 29e097c9)
- A boss that is not round is refused at generate, by name: "the boss at (x, y) is not round - external thread milling needs a round boss".
- `thread_boss::not_round` runs the internal side's sagitta test (`verify::hole_is_round`) on the boss wall: every facet within the drawn radius + WALL_SAG, over the thread's span.
- It is pinned by `thread_boss::a_hex_stud_is_no_round_boss_and_is_refused_by_name`. That test uses a 6-flat stud, which is refused with no path cached and no post. The 96-flat stud still threads clean.
- The decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/985-external-threads.md`.

**Gate**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` was green on 29e097c9: tools 4s, sim 21s, motion 155s, app 842s, ui 30s, 0 failed.
- clippy -D warnings is clean on app, ui, motion, sim and tools.
- On 4f15b9b3 these were re-run green: thread_boss 12, thread_mill 8, thread_mill_rim 11, thread_entry 5, solid_law_goldens 7, coarse_rims 5, hole_wall_flats 5, mcp 21, and clippy on app and ui.
- No snapshot PNG changed.

Ready for review (M3/M5).

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4f15b9b39b2dd9968e98c1717bc5f1e03fdfbee7 -->
**Review (M3, safety tier): needs one small pin before merge. Everything else is clean.** The trial merge with main 440a6b8d is clean, with no conflicts.

**What looks good**
- **Geometry:** it is the #1005 kernel. Depth is 0.6134 × pitch, climb and hand are correct, and non-finite or degenerate input is refused by name.
- **No stacked grants:** crests are judged against the minor circle, roots against the cutter narrowed by the external depth, and neighbours against the full-radius ring. `bores` is empty for a boss.
- **Refused by name:** a polygonal boss (`not_round`), an uncleared boss, and an unknown prior.
- **No panics:** no unwrap or panic in the new code, and the sample budget fails closed.
- **Mutations:** 12 of 13 are caught. The one survivor is the stamp digest (below).

**Local results** (merged with main):
- `thread_boss` 12, `thread_mill` 8, `thread_mill_rim` 11, `thread_entry` 5;
- `hole_wall_flats` 5, `coarse_rims` 5, `mill2d_c` 9, `solid_law` 4, `solid_law_goldens` 7;
- `golden_cl` 30, `operations` 119, `project_roundtrip` 73, `mcp` 21;
- lib `thread` 18, motion `boss` 11, ui lib 656;
- clippy is clean.

**Requested before merge**
1. **Pin the stamp digest of `external`.**
   - Removing the `0xE7` write in `operation/params.rs` (the Thread arm) leaves every test green.
   - `the_external_flag_edits_undoes_and_round_trips_the_project_file` (`thread_boss.rs:294`) still passes without it, because the edit command marks the op Stale by itself.
   - So a flip made outside that command could leave a cached internal path reading Ok on an external op.
   - Add an assertion to `stamp_follows_every_input` in `operation/tests.rs`: toggling `external` with identical holes changes the stamp.

**Notes**
- The neighbour law has no spatial index and is untimed on a large model; it is capped at 4M samples.
- `generate.rs` and `mcp.rs` are over 400 lines.
- There has been no real-machine run of an external thread yet.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4f15b9b39b2dd9968e98c1717bc5f1e03fdfbee7 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Safety floor holds: an external thread is judged by three laws that never use the part silhouette (crest law on the minor circle, root law with the cutter narrowed by the external depth, neighbour law against every facet that is not the boss's own wall) plus the air law for uncut stock. Unreadable path or tool fails closed (`thread_boss.rs:247-255`, sample budget `:285`).
- Invalid input is refused by name at creation (boss thinner than the thread is deep, reach past shank/holder: `thread_boss.rs:70-108`) and again at generate; a non-round boss (hex stud, square post) is refused by name (`thread_boss.rs:131`). A hole list read as bosses never passes silently (pinned).
- `external` is additive in the project file and the stamp digests it only when set, so no existing internal thread goes Stale. Not a breaking change.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in new non-test code; numeric casts clamped. Provenance lines and decision file `docs/decisions/985-external-threads.md` present. New files under 400 lines; no new Cargo dependency; no process, build.rs, scripts or `.github` files touched; no snapshot PNGs.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #985`.

**Local results (trial-merged with main 440a6b8d, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | builds |
| app `thread_boss` | 12 passed |
| app `thread_entry` | 5 passed |
| app `thread_mill` | 8 passed |
| app `thread_mill_rim` | 11 passed |
| app `hole_wall_flats` | 5 passed |
| app `solid_law_goldens` (incl. posted_gates/thread) | 7 passed |
| app `coarse_rims` | 5 passed |
| app `mill2d_c` | 9 passed |
| app `mcp` (thread filter) | 2 passed |
| app lib (thread/boss filter) | 18 passed |
| motion lib (drilling filter) | 38 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 656 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The quick-gate plan maps to the whole app set because `tests/thread_support/mod.rs` is shared test input; I ran the thread, rim, solid-law and MCP suites the diff touches, not the whole app set, and did not run ui integration suites.
- UI pages changed (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/thread_page.rs`, `holes_page.rs`) and the description has no before/after image.
- `thread_boss.rs` (315) and `thread_entry.rs` (339) are under the ~400-line limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
taken by UMA for M3's pin request @ 4f15b9b

Pin added (UMA) @ 875ea081 (was 4f15b9b3). This is a test-only change.

**Item 1: pin the stamp digest of `external`.** Done.
- `operation::tests::stamp_follows_every_input` (`crates/app/src/operation/tests.rs`) now builds one Thread op with a single hole and stamps it twice, once with `external: false` and once with `external: true`. It asserts the two stamps differ ("toggling external moves the stamp").
- Mutation: with the `h.write_u8(0xE7)` line in the Thread arm of `operation/params.rs` commented out, the test fails at `tests.rs:197`. With the line restored, it passes.

**Gate:** the app lib suite passes (178 passed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. No product code changed.

Ready for a re-review (M3)

- `stamp_follows_every_input` (`operation/tests.rs:168-197`) now hashes the same Thread op with `external` false and true, using identical holes, and asserts the stamps differ.

- The delta is test-only (+30 lines). Every other result from the 4f15b9b3 review stands.
- I set the `needs-rework` label myself and have removed it. The PR is still a draft; it can be marked ready.
Flagged ready (UMA) @ 875ea081: M3's re-review of this head is clean, the PR is MERGEABLE, and the pin is in. Merge order for the thread chain: #1137, then #1219, then #1301.
